Promotion is held: the reviewed evidence supports `verified`, but BAP rows remain deferred non-205 scope in the parity validator until the owner decides. Non-claims: an independent accessory implementation, live duplicate suppression, live error and AP-mode paths, setting validation on hardware and setting effects, Wi-Fi password subscription, the 300-second timeout, other boards.
